entries.title: Ask HN: Has anyone ever been hired from “Who wants to be hired?” threads?
entries.author: threwawasy1228
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Has anyone ever been hired from “Who wants to be hired?” threads?
entries.excerpt: Just a simple question, I have seen stories of people who were hired based on the job postings threads. Never once have I heard of anyone getting anything other than recruiter spam from the Ask HN: Who wants to be Hired threads. I think it might be useful to hear stories either way. Were you hired after someone contacted you? Did you receive responses that weren't recruiter-spam from your posts there?
entries.guide_zh: 求职自荐帖真的带来过录用吗，发帖者寻找通过该栏目找到工作的人。

entries.title: Ask HN: How do you deal with professional envy?
entries.author: cneurotic
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How do you deal with professional envy?
entries.excerpt: I think everyone feels envious of a high-flying peer once in a while. Or at least, I definitely do. When someone younger than me, in my field, is making more money / getting more acclaim / winning praise from people I respect, it makes me seethe. Sometimes I even waste my time looking for a way to invalidate them, to put an asterisk* on their success, so I can feel better about myself. Does this happen to anyone else? What do you do about it?
entries.guide_zh: 看到年轻同行升职加薪时心生嫉妒，如何处理这种职业比较？

entries.title: Ask HN: Are Lucene/Solr/ES Still Used for Search?
entries.author: lovelearning
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Are Lucene/Solr/ES Still Used for Search?
entries.excerpt: I casually visit jobs/freelancing sites once in a while. I don't see as much demand for Lucene/Solr/ES skills for website / text / document search or other kinds of information retrieval, as I used to about 4-5 years ago. ES seems to be the most popular but only in its ELK avatar for devops dashboards. What technologies are you people using for text or document or website search nowadays?
entries.guide_zh: 招聘中较少看到相关需求，Lucene、Solr 和 Elasticsearch 还常用吗？
